```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Simulate Vitals Data with Duplicates ####
set.seed(42)

n_subj <- 60
n_visits <- 10
subjects <- paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_subj))
sites <- paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", rep(1:6, each = 10)))

Mapped_SUBJ <- data.frame(
  subjid = subjects,
  invid = sites,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Generate VS data
vs_rows <- expand.grid(subjid = subjects, visit = 1:n_visits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vs_rows$vs_dt <- as.Date("2024-01-01") + (vs_rows$visit - 1) * 30
vs_rows$weight <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 75, 10), 1)
vs_rows$sysbp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 125, 15), 0)
vs_rows$diabp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 80, 10), 0)

# Inject ~10% duplicates per measure
inject_duplicates <- function(values, subjects, rate = 0.10) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) <= 1) next
    n_dup <- max(1, round(length(idx[-1]) * rate))
    dup_pos <- sample(idx[-1], n_dup)
    for (p in dup_pos) {
      prior <- idx[idx < p]
      values[p] <- values[sample(prior, 1)]
    }
  }
  values
}

vs_rows$weight <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$weight, vs_rows$subjid)
vs_rows$sysbp <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$sysbp, vs_rows$subjid)
vs_rows$diabp <- inject_duplicates(vs_rows$diabp, vs_rows$subjid)

Mapped_VS <- vs_rows[, c("subjid", "vs_dt", "weight", "sysbp", "diabp")]
```

```{r compute-metrics}
#### Compute kri0016 (Duplicate Weight Rate) for simulated data ####
# Run the kri0016 pipeline steps on the simulated data so metric badges appear in the report.
flagged_weight <- Flag_Duplicates(
  df = Mapped_VS,
  strSubjectCol = "subjid",
  strDateCol = "vs_dt",
  strValueCol = "weight"
)
analysis_input <- gsm.core::Input_Rate(
  dfSubjects = Mapped_SUBJ,
  dfNumerator = flagged_weight,
  dfDenominator = flagged_weight,
  strSubjectCol = "subjid",
  strGroupCol = "invid",
  strGroupLevel = "Site",
  strNumeratorMethod = "Sum",
  strNumeratorCol = "is_duplicate",
  strDenominatorMethod = "Count"
)
analysis_transformed <- gsm.core::Transform_Rate(analysis_input)
analysis_analyzed <- gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox(analysis_transformed, strType = "binary")
analysis_flagged <- gsm.core::Flag_NormalApprox(
  analysis_analyzed,
  vThreshold = c(2, 3),
  vFlag = c(0, 1, 2)
)

# Format as reportingResults and add kri0016 MetricID
kri0016_results <- data.frame(
  GroupID = analysis_flagged$GroupID,
  GroupLevel = analysis_flagged$GroupLevel,
  Numerator = analysis_flagged$Numerator,
  Denominator = analysis_flagged$Denominator,
  Metric = analysis_flagged$Metric,
  Score = analysis_flagged$Score,
  Flag = analysis_flagged$Flag,
  MetricID = "Analysis_kri0016",
  SnapshotDate = Sys.Date(),
  StudyID = "SIM001",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Combine with existing reportingResults for full context
dfReportingResults <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingResults[, names(kri0016_results)],
  kri0016_results
)

# Build reportingMetrics entry for kri0016
kri0016_metric <- data.frame(
  MetricID = "Analysis_kri0016",
  Metric = "Duplicate Weight Record Rate",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dfReportingMetrics <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingMetrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(kri0016_metric)), drop = FALSE],
  kri0016_metric[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(kri0016_metric)), drop = FALSE]
)
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
#### Generate Record Duplication Report ####
w <- Report_RecordDuplication(
  dfMappedVS = Mapped_VS,
  dfMappedSUBJ = Mapped_SUBJ,
  vMeasuresVS = c("weight", "sysbp", "diabp"),
  dfReportingResults = dfReportingResults,
  dfReportingMetrics = dfReportingMetrics,
  strGroupLevel = "Site"
)
w
```
